name: Aabaco Plastics Inc
old_description: Aabaco Plastics is the reliable source for packaging solutions. Solving packaging problems since 1952 has earned us the reputation for being the "go-to guys" when the pressure is on.
about:
Established in 1952 in Garfield Heights, Ohio, Aabaco Plastics began as a packaging solutions provider focused on solving challenging packaging problems. The company has built a reputation as a go-to resource for urgent packaging needs.

Aabaco Plastics operates as a designer, fabricator, converter, and distributor of flexible plastic packaging. Its product line includes flat and gusseted bags, ziplock bags, bubble bags, foam bags, poly mailers, trash bags, pallet covers, construction and agricultural film, tarps, layflat tubing, sheeting, top sheets, and closures. The company offers package design, graphic design, test sampling, and printing services to support custom packaging development.

The company serves customers across industries requiring flexible plastic packaging, though specific sectors are not detailed in its public materials. Its capabilities span from design through fabrication and conversion, enabling both stock and custom orders.

Aabaco Plastics emphasizes superior quality, on-time delivery, and competitive pricing as standard service levels. It highlights the ability to achieve "miracle deliveries" on both stock and non-stock sizes on a weekly basis, backed by a team with deep knowledge of current packaging technology and creative problem-solving.
